population.layout: original development query order then proposal, exactly cmd_rollouts layout; populations never cross batches

scores.input: continuous predicted endpoint x_hat,b_hat; no decoded event used for selection
scores.xtb: exact input_config xtb block; reused xtb_energy_kcal and _force_job
scores.raw: E_xTB(x)-E_R; success before failure then increasing barrier

relaxed.clip: scale entire step if any atom exceeds cap; then centered
relaxed.failure: any distance <0.5A, SCF failure, invalid direction, or nonfinite value
relaxed.calls: 23 relaxation/final-energy/curvature calls plus one raw-energy diagnostic; count actual calls

scores.s0_branch: if negative curvature success count divided by all 558 real TS records is <0.5, disable curvature layers for every relaxed selection and endpoint score; failures remain last

restart.noise: symmetric_noise and geometry_noise in first n atoms; addressed_seed('explore_smc_clone', noise_role='joint_b' or 'joint_x', query=qid, training_seed=seed, proposal=ancestor_proposal, checkpoint_step=k_c); no arm name
restart.layout: survivors retain original slots; rank-ordered rejected slots paired with rank-ordered survivors
restart.continuation: survivors use b_trace[k_c],x_trace[k_c]; clones use restart; sampler.rollout start=k_c, n_steps=50, geometry_lead3

endpoint.score: relaxed for all arms on final b,x
endpoint.event_score: minimum candidate (layer,barrier) among legal instances of each distinct event; event ties sha256(channel_id)

aggregation: compute (parent,training_seed) population metrics then mean over three seeds; paired parent differences; cluster_summary(values, parent split_group), two-sided 95%
comparisons: each relaxed_s and raw_s vs none and random_s; each relaxed_s vs raw_s; each random_s vs none

reading.IN_GENERATION_SELECTION_HELPS: none CI lower>0 and random CI lower>0
reading.NOT_PHYSICS_SPECIFIC: none CI lower>0 and random CI contains 0
reading.uncovered_case: positive none interval and strictly negative random interval is explicitly unclassified; do not reinterpret frozen table

diagnostics: none checkpoint raw/relaxed energy vs known final catalogue barrier within_parent_rho min_n=4 and >=2 target values, computed per seed then average complete three-seed parents
false prune conditional on none population best present: no selected survivor has best in none endpoint; average eligible seeds within parent
clone endpoint event differs from corresponding none ancestor endpoint
best channel appears only in clones
score layers, failures, energy drop quantiles, actual calls and elapsed time

gates.s0: 558 rows, raw absolute difference <=1e-6 each; check-A min-pooled rho difference <1e-9
gates.c1: none endpoint event and proxy_status 100% equal pg1; raw score error <=1e-6 at all four checkpoints; paired failures explicitly counted
gates.c2: each arm survivor endpoint event agreement >=0.999; report max absolute coordinate difference
gates.failure: stop, record options and costs; no scientific redesign to bypass failure

resource_limits.gpu: Slurm main gpu:pro6000:1, <=60 min/job, smc- prefix, dependency on every existing user job

limitations: All results exploratory; development set repeatedly reused
checkpoint 0.7 and geometry_lead3 informed by previous development results
closed-world hit metrics count outside-catalogue channels as misses
xTB and omegaB97X barrier rankings disagree
proxy event/reference hits do not certify transition states
selection of best known channel is not a chemical conclusion
